description.en:
The female general He Yan tragically dies after being betrayed, only to be reborn as a weak young girl. Vowing to reclaim everything she lost, she returns to the army under a new identity in order to: fight on the battlefield once more, gain a noble title for herself, and make a name for herself throughout all of China. 

Along the way, she reunites with her former rival—the long wolf young general, Xiao Jue. Side-by-side they march onto the battlefield together, forging a new legend of the "Twin Generals". Entangled between love and hate, ensnared in treacherous power struggles, witness how He Yan earns her title and gains the respect of the world.

Jiang Wang was betrayed by his sworn brother Fang Pengju, who stole the Daoist Academy's reward of a Meridian Opening pill that he had earned with his blood and sweat. On the verge of death, he inherited the relics of Zuo Guanglie, the genius of the Chu Dynasty, opened his meridians and embarked on the path of cultivation. He was confused and hesitant, but he always held on to the light in his heart, which was a pure heart that remained true to its original intention.

Believing that the Demon King had abducted his sister, he decided to crossdress to infiltrate the Demon King’s city to save his sister. Zhu Xiao Ou originally wanted to live a life of suffering, waiting for the day that he would die, but he was suddenly asked to be the leader of a sect! A max level celestial master ancestor came down from the sky, and his handsomeness is off the charts! Relying on this master ancestor to support his back, Zhu Xiao Ou started to open the way to heaven, to earth and to the exotic flowers! His soul reincarnated in LingXi Tang, the youngest daughter of the Tang family who'd died at a young age over 10 years ago. He must use his new identity to protect his teenage self, investigate the reason behind his best friend's backstabbing behavior, and expose his wife-to-be's true personality.

Xiao Nuo, better known as Secretary Xiao, is the dedicated and hardworking secretary of Mo Yanchuan. Mo Yanchuan, better known as President Mo, is the cold and aloof president and heir of Mo Electronics Group.

Because of a sex scene, a bright and simple young man (Shen Che), became entangled with the arrogant and two-faced iceberg and campus beau (Qin Xiu), who is sharp-tongued, mercurial, and unreasonable. Thus begins the hilarious and tear-jerking struggle of the future movie emperor from film academy to entertainment circle! This story teaches us that if you give in to lust once, then your back will pay the price for a lifetime! One can’t afford to love beautiful women or offend beautiful men. One absolutely cannot afford to offend beautiful tops!
description.es: Una tragedia provocada por una escena de sexo. Un joven alegre, amable y honesto (Che Shen), debido a una escena de sexo se ve enredado con un tsundere doble cara, malvado y sabelotodo, que no tiene piedad, cruel y antipático, la belleza del campus (Qin Xiu). ¡Así comienza el la divertida y conmovedora historia de la lucha de la futura superestrella desde la academia de cine hasta la industria del entretenimiento! Esta historia nos enseña que una vez que te aferras a la belleza, no serás capaz de levantarte! ¡Una mujer hermosa no puede permitirse el lujo de amar, un hombre hermoso no puede permitirse el lujo de herir, y un uke hermoso no puede permitirse el lujo de ofender!

After the First World War ended, during a charity banquet held with extra care, the appearance of a specific someone had completely turned her life upside down and caused her to be dragged into the murder case of one of the aristocrats. description.en:
To celebrate the 10th anniversary of the Louvre's comic collection, a series of international exhibitions has been scheduled.

The Taipei Montue Museum, followed by the Tainan Cultural Center, inaugurated the Taiwanese part of this major retrospective by exhibiting more than two hundred original plates, preparatory drawings and video installations.

Then, between August 2016 and September 2017, the exhibition follows a traveling tour through Japan, starting with the Mori Arts Center Gallery in Tokyo. At each stage of the exhibition, Taiwanese and then Japanese artists were invited to participate in this project. It is their work that we reproduce here.

Their personal looks, their original cultures and their singular expressions send back new images of the Louvre,

From Wikipedia:
Katsuya Terada is probably best known in the United States as the character-designer for the animated film Blood: The Last Vampire. He has also done work related to American comics, such as Iron Man and Hellboy (one of his illustrations was used for an official statuette of Hellboy). He also made additional contributions to old issues of Nintendo Power. In Japan, he is probably best known for the Tantei Jingūji Saburō mystery-adventure video game series.

Terada has defined himself as a "rakugaki" artist, more of a philosophy than a style of drawing, in which one draws a little everywhere, all the time, without thinking too much, on notebooks etc. He is a very prolific artist; one of his collections of sketches numbers more than 1000 pages, appropriately called Rakuga King.

He has done very little group-drawn work (an exception being the manga Saiyukiden Daienou (Monkey King)), his principal activities being illustration and character design.

His use of CG tools is integrated very well in his illustrations, giving his work a vivid and rich appearance. Most distinctive, though, are the female faces in his work, which could be described as “cute”, but with a dangerous or elusive character to the eyes. He has admitted various influences on his work, particularly European ones, like Jean Giraud (a.k.a. Moebius) and the magazine Métal Hurlant which he has said gave him a taste for strong women who are slightly stripped.
Won the Seiun Award for Best Artist in 2002.

Shin-ichi Sakamoto (Japanese: 坂本眞一, Hepburn: Sakamoto Shin-ichi, born July 19, 1972) is a Japanese manga artist known for his seinen manga series Kokou no Hito and the Innocent duology. Both Kokou no Hito and Innocent were awarded an Excellence Award at the Japan Media Arts Festival. His newest series #DRCL midnight children began serialization in Grand Jump in 2021.

A white-haired young man, wrapped in a seven-colored evil dragon and carrying an ancient stone sarcophagus on his shoulder, gazes up at the supreme beings of the heavens and the Ancestors of the Ancient Wonders.

With a faint smile, he utters—

“Gentlemen, if I were to tell you that this sarcophagus of mine has buried even the heavens… would you believe me?”
description.zh: 书旗小说出品，神居动漫承制，根据汉隶原著小说改编，一名身缠七彩恶龙、肩扛古老石棺的白发青年，仰望高高在上的诸天至尊、万古道祖，淡淡道：“诸位，我说我这石棺葬过天，你们信么？”

description.en: After the war, humanity struggling to survive on a "ruined" planet mysteriously gained two abilities, everyone uses them to regain their own strength... But little is known about their origin... "To unravel the truth about them..." 12 years later, Noah, who received his first mission, on his way to regroup with another settlement in a foreign area... Stumbled amid an attack by the "Black Thunder", a highly wanted criminal. So in the process of clarifying his ideals, Noah gets caught up in another conspiracy...

altTitles.en: The Prodigal Son of Ming Dynasty

description.en:
Q: What kind of person is Fang Ji Fan?
His Father, the General: "My failure of a son".
His Majesty the Emperor: "I get a headache every time he opens his mouth. When he steps towards me, I want to run".
His Highness the Prince: "I get criticized everyday because of him".
Fang Ji Fan: "I’m here, my friends, did you miss me?".
The General, Emperor, and Prince: "Let’s get out of here!!"

description.en: After transmigrating to the modern age and being an idol for 3 years, Ophelia, the Princess of the Nariel Empire, wakes up and finds that she has returned to her original world, but she has become a player Sea God! The gentle and lovely Holy Saint, the healthy and bright Paladin, and even the rich second generation playboy have all become a fish in her fish pond! She didn't even let go of her own second brother! However, her first love, Holst, is distancing from her, and it seems that her transmigration may very well be a well-designed conspiracy...

description.en: Ye Fan was reborn as a strange sword with its own upgrade system. Ye Fan has been continuously upgraded through the killing experience of the sword masters of the past dynasties, and has become an evil sword that everyone in another world competes for. As soon as the evil sword was born, it would definitely set off a bloody storm, and Ye Fan also worked hard to get rid of the sword body and restore his human form as soon as possible…

description.en: A strange woman’s video message made me miss my girlfriend’s date. Has my father who died in the fire reappeared? Retired firefighters are infected with the “otherworldly virus”. Could it be an evolution or mutation catalyst? The mysterious Solomon girl, the stunning assassin demon hunter, as well as ghouls, Taoist priests, and immortals. The major sects and factions are ready to move, and the mysterious Creator is planning to rule the world again… Who is plotting all of this?

It is said that when the lifespan of a human being come to its end, it is necessary to leave behind everything; family, friends, achievements, even love and meet black and white messengers who will lead them to the cycle of reincarnation. However, the infatuations and love in mind; engraved in the bone, how can it be so easy to give it up. When love has gone through the battle of time either it is it still flawless or the wreckage full of holes.

Another Translation
Legend says that when one’s time is up, only when all traces of love from your previous life must be erased, led by the deities of the Impermanence of Black and White , will you be reborn. And yet a breathtaking, extraordinary love that makes you lose your mind could never be so easily forgotten. When love undergoes the test of time, is what remains the same, pure love, or will that love be battered and bruised, unrecognizable?

description.en: As a handsome and rich young master of a wealthy family, women and marriage for him are playthings. But such flawless he, actually was abandoned in his university life by a poor boy whose father died early. Meet again, he decided must not let him go...
description.es: ¿Que trucos puede usar el perfecto rico de segunda generacion para recuperar el amor de su antiguo superior? Presencia este magico amor que es como los fuegos artificiales
description.fr:
Comment un homme riche et parfait peut-il courir après son misérable premier amour ? L'histoire de cet amour féerique, comme un feu d'artifice ! Si chaque relation doit être entretenue, qu'est notre amour ? Le mien est un feu d'artifice. C'est court ? Non, c'est extraordinaire !   
En tant qu'incroyable et riche jeune chef d'une grande famille, les femmes et le mariage sont pour lui de vulgaires jeux. Mais aussi infaillible soit-il, il a en fait été abandonné dans sa vie universitaire, par un garçon dont le père est mort jeune. En se rencontrant une nouvelle fois, il décide de ne pas le laisser une seconde fois.
